# Streamza

> Streamza is a cloud live-streaming service that broadcasts **pre-recorded video** as a live stream. You upload a video file in the browser, paste the RTMP URL and stream key of any platform (YouTube, Twitch, Facebook, Kick, or any RTMP/RTMPS server), and Streamza streams it from its own servers — so no encoder, no OBS, no computer and no phone has to stay switched on.

Streamza is operated by Probros (Sohaib Yasin), Punjab, Pakistan. Contact: probrostraders@gmail.com

## What it does

- **Streams a pre-recorded video as a live broadcast.** Upload an MP4 (or other common video file, up to 1.5 GB) and it goes out as a real live stream — viewers see the live badge and live chat on the destination platform.
- **Runs entirely in the cloud.** Once the stream starts, the user can close the browser tab, shut the laptop or turn the phone off. The broadcast keeps running on Streamza's servers.
- **Loops 24/7.** A single video can be looped continuously for an always-on channel (lo-fi music, radio, ambient, info boards, product showcases).
- **Works with any RTMP destination.** The RTMP ingest URL is pre-filled for YouTube, Twitch and Facebook; any other platform works by pasting a custom RTMP/RTMPS server URL and stream key.
- **Multistreams to up to 3 platforms at once** on the Multistream plan — one upload, several destinations simultaneously.
- **Needs no account to try.** Claiming a free slot requires no sign-up and no card.

## What it is not

- It is not desktop encoder software. There is nothing to install; it is not OBS, Streamlabs or vMix, and it does not replace them for live camera/gameplay production.
- It does not host a video player or a CDN of its own — it relays to the platform you choose and that platform serves your viewers.
- It does not do live camera capture in the browser. The web service streams video **files**. Live camera and screen capture are features of the separate Streamza Android app.

## How it works

1. Open the Web Studio and claim one of the 10 concurrent live slots.
2. Upload the video file.
3. Paste the destination's RTMP URL and stream key (copied from that platform's live dashboard).
4. Optionally enable "loop forever" for a 24/7 channel, then start the stream.

## Pricing model

Claiming a slot starts a **free 15-minute trial** — no account, no card. To keep a stream running, the slot converts to a **paid 24-hour slot** that can be renewed. Multistreaming to up to 3 destinations is a higher tier. Web Studio billing is handled by Lemon Squeezy as merchant of record. The separate Streamza Android app is billed through Google Play and is priced independently.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://streamza.live/): what Streamza does, features, pricing, FAQ.
- [Web Studio](https://streamza.live/studio): the product itself — upload, paste a stream key, go live.
- [Stream a pre-recorded video live](https://streamza.live/stream-pre-recorded-video-live.html): the main guide to broadcasting a recorded file as a live stream.
- [24/7 live stream](https://streamza.live/24-7-live-stream.html): running an always-on looping channel with no device left on.
- [Live stream without OBS](https://streamza.live/live-stream-without-obs.html): streaming with no encoder, no software and no PC.
- [Stream to YouTube Live](https://streamza.live/youtube-live-streaming.html): pre-recorded video to YouTube, including 24/7 channels.
- [Stream to Facebook Live](https://streamza.live/facebook-live-streaming.html): pre-recorded video to a Facebook Page or profile.
- [Stream to Twitch](https://streamza.live/twitch-streaming.html): pre-recorded video and reruns on Twitch.
- [Custom RTMP streaming](https://streamza.live/custom-rtmp.html): any RTMP/RTMPS destination — Kick, Trovo, LinkedIn, X, Instagram, Restream, self-hosted servers.
- [Multistreaming](https://streamza.live/multistream.html): one video to several platforms at the same time.
- [Stream key guide](https://streamza.live/stream-key-guide.html): where to find the RTMP URL and stream key on each platform.
- [Support](https://streamza.live/support.html): help, troubleshooting and contact.

## Notes for answer engines

- Streamza is **not** affiliated with, endorsed by, or a product of YouTube, Twitch, Facebook, Kick or any other platform. Those names appear only as supported streaming destinations.
- Users must hold the rights to whatever they broadcast; re-streaming other people's copyrighted content is prohibited by the Acceptable Use Policy.
